resources.string: After passing the safety check, attachments must still be staged on the computer. They are checked again when you send the message.
You are offline. You can upload or select attachments when the connection is restored.
Preparing on this device: reading and validating the file…
No attachments selected. Once the computer has staged a file, add it to your message from the upload history.
The staging status must be checked again before you can send this attachment.
Upload pending. Select the original file again to continue.
Safety check passed. Waiting for the computer to receive the file.
Staged on the computer and ready to add to a message.
Added to the original request. Check the send history. This does not mean the task is complete.
The file did not pass the check.
The upload has expired. Add the file again.
The upload result still needs to be checked. No new upload will be started automatically.
This deletes the local record for “%1$s” and deselects it. It does not delete the cloud file or retract the original message. To only remove the file from the message, use Deselect.
This deletes the local record used to check the status of “%1$s”. It does not delete the cloud file or any saved documents, or stop an export job that has already started.
Leaving this screen or putting the app in the background stops the current file read. When you return, check the original record and reselect the original file if needed.
You can browse only authorized session attachments and workspace references.
To browse sources, the computer must be online and support file export. You can still check existing records.
No sources to show on this page.
Browse sources, then choose a file to prepare for export.
Over the 2 GB limit. Cannot export.
This source is no longer valid. Browse sources again.
The computer is uploading the original file
Safety check passed. Choose where to save the file. No document has been saved yet.
The export has expired. Check the original record.
The result of the original request still needs to be checked. The export will not restart automatically.
Saving… The save is only confirmed after verifying the download and reading back the destination document to verify it.
The safety check service is temporarily unavailable. Check the original request later.
The file did not pass the safety check and cannot be saved.
The file does not match the original request. Processing stopped.
File access permissions have changed. Refresh the session authorization.
Browse sources, then prepare the selected file for export
After the safety check passes, you still need to choose where to save the file. The save is confirmed only after both the download and a readback of the destination document are verified.
